clause: Glyph browser / insert-glyph + user glyph sets [STU-TYP-020,STU-TYP-021]

scope.summary: Provide a glyph panel that browses every glyph in the active font, filters to alternates-for-selection and recently-used, inserts any glyph (including alternates unreachable by keyboard), and offers on-canvas alternate suggestions where the font provides them (PS Glyphs panel + on-canvas alternates; ID/AI Glyphs). User glyph sets: the operator/model MAY define named glyph sets that store chosen glyphs (optionally remembering their font) for reuse across documents (InDesign glyph sets).
acceptance_criteria: glyph browser with alternates/recent + on-canvas suggestions; named reusable user glyph sets
expected_tests: live: glyph panel browses all glyphs, filters alternates/recent, inserts keyboard-unreachable alternate; on-canvas alternate suggestion
test: named user glyph set stores glyphs (+font) reusable across documents

risk_if_missed: No glyph access; alternates/special glyphs unreachable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
